concepts.title: Cross-entropy loss
concepts.description: Logits are pre-softmax real-valued scores; cross-entropy / max-likelihood are computed on logits directly to avoid the loss of precision from softmax.

concepts.title: torch.linalg.solve
concepts.description: torch.linalg.solve raises a RuntimeError when the coefficient matrix is singular (e.g. ray and segment are exactly parallel); this must be caught or otherwise handled.

concepts.title: optimizer.zero_grad()
concepts.description: Setting param.grad = None is preferred over zeroing the existing tensor: it saves memory and is the PyTorch convention; the next .backward() re-creates it.

concepts.title: Conv output size formula
concepts.description: output_size = 1 + (input_size + 2*padding - kernel_size) // stride along each spatial dim; derivable from how the kernel slides over the input.

concepts.title: Adam update rule
concepts.description: Combines Adam-style EMA of first moment m_t and second moment v_t with bias correction (1 - beta^t), giving a per-parameter, momentum-like, adaptive optimizer.

concepts.title: Reparameterization trick
concepts.description: Instead of a single latent vector the encoder outputs a Gaussian parameterized by mean and log std; using log_sigma keeps sigma positive automatically.

concepts.title: wandb sweep configuration
concepts.description: Dict-of-distributions specifying hyperparameter search: method (random/grid/bayes), metric (name+goal), and parameters (per-hparam distribution).

concepts.title: wandb.init / watch / log / finish
concepts.description: Initialize a run with wandb.init(project,name,config), call wandb.watch(model) to log gradients/params, wandb.log({k:v}, step=...) to record metrics, and wandb.finish() at the end.

concepts.title: AdamW decoupled weight decay
concepts.description: Apply weight decay directly to the parameters (theta *= 1 - lr * lambda) instead of adding into the gradient; this is the 'correct' form mathematically equivalent to a Gaussian prior.

concepts.title: BatchNorm2d channel-wise normalization
concepts.description: BatchNorm tracks per-channel mean and variance via exponentially weighted moving averages (controlled by momentum); these buffers are used at eval time instead of batch statistics.

concepts.title: torch.cat existing dimension
concepts.description: Combine a list of equally-shaped tensors into a new tensor with an additional leading dim (controlled by `dim`); building block for assembling matrices and time series.

concepts.title: VAE total loss = reconstruction + KL
concepts.description: VAE training minimizes the negative Evidence Lower Bound: -ELBO = reconstruction term + KL divergence between encoder posterior and prior; treats VAE as variational inference.

concepts.title: DataLoader for batched iteration
concepts.description: Train loaders should shuffle each epoch to decorrelate batches; test loaders generally pass shuffle=False because order does not matter for metrics.

concepts.title: GAN minimax loss
concepts.description: GAN discriminator loss is implicitly BCE on logits-of-real-vs-fake (computed manually here via log D(x) and log(1-D(G(z))) terms).

concepts.title: torch.inference_mode context
concepts.description: Suppress autograd graph creation for a block; common alternative to inference_mode for code that runs under user-facing autograd semantics.

concepts.title: nn.Parameter wrapper
concepts.description: Wrapping a tensor in nn.Parameter registers it as a learnable parameter inside a Module so it appears in .parameters() and gets updated by optimizers.

concepts.title: Stride tuple semantics
concepts.description: A tensor's stride tuple gives the number of memory elements to step when advancing one position in each dimension. Storage layout is independent of shape.

concepts.title: Tensor.grad attribute
concepts.description: After loss.backward(), every leaf parameter with requires_grad=True has a .grad tensor of the same shape; this is what optimizers update.

concepts.title: 1D convolution via strided expansion
concepts.description: Materialize a (B, C, oh, ow, kh, kw) view of the input where the (oh, ow) axes are sliding window positions; combined with einsum it yields the convolution result.

concepts.title: force_pair helper / IntOrPair type
concepts.description: Helper that normalises a hyperparameter that may be either an int or a tuple of two ints into a (h, w) pair; used for stride, padding, kernel_size.

concepts.title: fractional_stride_1d insert zeros
concepts.description: Insert stride-1 zeros between input elements before applying a minimal transposed conv; equivalent to taking strides of 1/stride over the output (hence 'fractionally strided').

concepts.title: Padding via new_full + slice copy
concepts.description: Implement padding by allocating a larger tensor pre-filled with pad_value and writing the input into the appropriate slice; avoids per-stride edge-case arithmetic.

concepts.title: DCGAN architecture
concepts.description: Generator stack: project+reshape -> repeated (ConvTranspose2d, BatchNorm, ReLU) -> Tanh. Discriminator mirror: (Conv2d, BatchNorm, LeakyReLU) -> flatten + Linear + Sigmoid. Activation size doubles per layer.

concepts.title: Detach fake image for D step
concepts.description: When training the discriminator on G's output, pass img_fake.detach() so gradients do not flow back into G during the D step; keeps G's update isolated.

concepts.title: torch.linalg.det
concepts.description: Detect singular matrices in a batch by computing their determinant and checking |det| < threshold; standard prelude to safe batched solves.

concepts.title: examples_seen as wandb step
concepts.description: Tracking examples_seen (total batch sizes summed) and passing it as wandb step lets you compare runs with different batch sizes on a common x-axis.

concepts.title: Module extra_repr method
concepts.description: Override extra_repr to produce an informative string when printing a module (used for hyperparameters like in_features, out_features).

concepts.title: Global average pool (channel mean)
concepts.description: Reduces (batch, channels, H, W) to (batch, channels) by averaging over the spatial dims; common pre-classifier layer in ResNets.

concepts.title: Gradient norm clipping
concepts.description: nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(params, max_norm) rescales gradients so their global norm does not exceed max_norm; stabilises training of unstable models like GANs.

concepts.title: float('inf') / t.inf as missing-distance sentinel
concepts.description: Set entries of a tensor satisfying a boolean mask to +/-inf, typically as a sentinel for 'no intersection' or padded-out maxpool entries.

concepts.title: Integer array indexing
concepts.description: Indexing one axis with arange(N) and another with a length-N label tensor selects (i, labels[i]) for each i; used to gather the true-class logit per example.

concepts.title: KL divergence to standard normal
concepts.description: Closed-form KL(N(mu, sigma^2) || N(0, 1)) = 0.5 * (mu^2 + sigma^2 - 1) - log(sigma); used as the regularizer in the VAE objective.

concepts.title: torch.linspace out= keyword argument
concepts.description: torch.linspace and other tensor-creation ops accept an `out=` tensor; writing the result directly into an existing tensor (often a view) instead of allocating a new one.

concepts.title: Log-uniform hyperparameter sampling
concepts.description: Sampling hyperparameters such as learning rate from a log-uniform distribution between [a, b] rather than uniform, because lr lives on a multiplicative scale.

concepts.title: torch.manual_seed for reproducibility
concepts.description: Fix the global PRNG seed so subsequent random ops give deterministic output (modulo CUDA non-determinism); used to compare optimizer trajectories and generator samples.

concepts.title: Matrix multiply via strides + elementwise + sum
concepts.description: Compute matrix products by stride-broadcasting both operands to a common 3D shape (i, j, k), elementwise multiplying, and summing over the contraction axis.

concepts.title: MSE reconstruction loss
concepts.description: nn.MSELoss()(target, prediction) — mean squared error between original image and decoder output, the basic autoencoder objective.

concepts.title: No activation on final output layer
concepts.description: Skip ReLU/activation on the very last layer of generators/decoders; final non-linearity (or linear output for logits) is chosen by task (Tanh for [-1,1] images, identity for logits).

concepts.title: tensor.requires_grad flag
concepts.description: An output tensor's requires_grad is True iff at least one input tensor has requires_grad True (and global tracking is on); leaf tensors set it explicitly.

concepts.title: Softmax along the class dimension
concepts.description: Convert logits to a probability distribution via softmax along the class dimension; followed by argmax to predict a class.

concepts.title: Tensor.item() to Python scalar
concepts.description: Calling `.item()` on a 0-dim tensor converts it to a plain Python scalar (int/float) for use in pure Python control flow.

concepts.title: Tensor zeros initialization
concepts.description: Creating a tensor pre-filled with zeros of a specified shape and dtype using `t.zeros((...), dtype=...)`, used as a scaffold to which values are subsequently written.

concepts.title: Topological sort via DFS
concepts.description: Order nodes from root (loss) outward so every backward call sees its inputs' gradients already computed; required to handle nodes with multiple downstream uses.

concepts.title: Random normal noise via torch.randn
concepts.description: Samples standard normal noise with the same shape and device as a reference tensor; used in reparameterization and GAN sampling.

concepts.title: Trace via diagonal as_strided
concepts.description: Extract the diagonal of an (n,n) matrix by viewing it with shape (n,) and stride (row_stride+col_stride); then sum for trace.

concepts.title: Asserting tensor shapes
concepts.description: Sprinkle `assert tensor.shape == (...)` after key reshape/repeat steps to fail loudly with a useful trace rather than later from an opaque downstream error.

concepts.title: Autoencoder architecture
concepts.description: Encoder compresses input to a low-dim latent z; decoder reconstructs the input from z. Trained by reconstruction loss (e.g. MSE) between input and output.

concepts.title: BlockGroup in ResNet
concepts.description: A BlockGroup is n_blocks ResidualBlocks chained; only the first uses the provided first_stride (and may need a 1x1 right branch); the rest are shape-preserving with identity right branch.

concepts.title: Boolean-mask broadcast assignment
concepts.description: Indexing a tensor with a boolean mask returns a contiguous tensor of selected entries; assigning a smaller-shape value broadcasts to fill all selected positions (e.g. mat[is_singular] = t.eye(2)).

concepts.title: broadcast collective
concepts.description: Sends a tensor from a source rank to all other ranks so they share the same value (e.g. initialise parameters identically across replicas).

concepts.title: NumPy/PyTorch broadcasting rules
concepts.description: When operating on tensors of different shapes, dimensions of size 1 are stretched to match larger shapes; missing leading dims are treated as size 1.

concepts.title: CelebA dataset
concepts.description: Large-scale celebrity face dataset (~200k images) commonly used for unsupervised generative model demos like DCGAN; loaded via HuggingFace, normalised to [-1,1].

concepts.title: CIFAR-10 dataset
concepts.description: 60k 32x32 colour images in 10 classes, 6k per class; used as the finetuning target after ResNet feature extraction.

concepts.title: Computational graph
concepts.description: A DAG where each node is a tensor and each edge records the function that produced it from its inputs; backprop traverses it right-to-left.

concepts.title: torch.cuda.is_available
concepts.description: Using torch.cuda.is_available() to detect whether a CUDA-capable GPU is reachable before moving tensors to it.

concepts.title: torch.cuda.empty_cache
concepts.description: Manually releases unused cached GPU memory back to the system. Often needed in long inference loops on the GPU.

concepts.title: Per-parameter all_reduce of .grad
concepts.description: In each step, every replica computes a local gradient on its own micro-batch; an all_reduce(mean) over gradients before optimizer.step keeps all replicas in lockstep.

concepts.title: @dataclass for training arguments
concepts.description: Use @dataclass to declare a typed bag of training hyperparameters (batch_size, epochs, lr) with defaults; cleanly passed to a Trainer class.

concepts.title: DCGAN-style weight initialization
concepts.description: Conv/ConvTranspose/Linear weights ~ N(0, 0.02); BatchNorm weights ~ N(1, 0.02); BatchNorm biases = 0. Set in-place via nn.init.normal_/constant_.

concepts.title: Tensor.detach().clone() snapshot
concepts.description: Detach removes the tensor from the autograd graph; clone makes an independent copy of the data. Together they capture an immutable snapshot for logging or replay.

concepts.title: Moving tensors between devices with .to/.cuda/.cpu
concepts.description: Tensors live on a device; `.to('cuda')` / `.cuda()` move them to GPU memory, `.to('cpu')` back. Methods return copies unless the device matches.

concepts.title: torch.distributed init_process_group
concepts.description: Initializes the collective communication backend (nccl/gloo) for a rank in a world_size; must be called before send/recv/all_reduce primitives.

concepts.title: DistributedSampler
concepts.description: DistributedSampler(trainset, num_replicas, rank) partitions data so each rank sees a disjoint subset (with set_epoch for reshuffling).

concepts.title: einops.einsum
concepts.description: Generalized einstein-summation with named axes; multiplies and sums over shared axes per a string pattern, e.g. 'nt dims, dims -> nt'.

concepts.title: einops.rearrange
concepts.description: Reshape/permute/reorder tensor axes via a pattern string like `"frames (y z) -> frames y z"`, naming axes for clarity.

concepts.title: einops.reduce
concepts.description: Reduce a tensor along named axes using `einops.reduce(t, pattern, op)` where op is one of 'min'/'max'/'sum'/'mean'.

concepts.title: einops.repeat
concepts.description: einops.repeat expands a tensor by inserting/repeating dims, e.g. "nrays p d -> nrays nsegments p d" with nsegments=NS, used to create pairs for batched ops.

concepts.title: Backward of exp via out
concepts.description: d/dx exp(x) = exp(x) = out, so exp_back returns out * grad_out — express the gradient using the already-computed forward output to avoid recomputing.

concepts.title: Forward hooks on nn.Module
concepts.description: module.register_forward_hook(fn) attaches fn(module, inputs, output) to run on every forward pass; useful for inspection (NaN-detection) and interpretability.

concepts.title: ImageNet normalization transform
concepts.description: Apply mean (0.485,0.456,0.406) and std (0.229,0.224,0.225) per RGB channel to inputs of pretrained ImageNet models; required for predictions to match.

concepts.title: jaxtyping Float[Tensor, ...] annotation
concepts.description: Using `Float[Tensor, "dim1 dim2"]` (and `Bool[Tensor, ...]`) from jaxtyping as documentation-style type hints that name the expected tensor dtype and shape dimensions.

concepts.title: Kaiming uniform initialization
concepts.description: Initialize weights uniformly in [-1/sqrt(N_in), +1/sqrt(N_in)] where N_in is the number of inputs to the unit (fan_in); the PyTorch default for Linear/Conv.

concepts.title: Transposed conv = flipped + padded conv
concepts.description: Implement transposed conv by flipping the kernel along its spatial dims and swapping in/out channel axes, then applying a regular convolution; the math identity that makes it 'transposed'.

concepts.title: Lambertian reflection model
concepts.description: Diffuse-surface lighting model where intensity is proportional to the cosine of the angle between surface normal and light direction (i.e. their dot product when both unit).

concepts.title: Latent bottleneck dimension
concepts.description: latent_dim_size is the size of the compressed representation between encoder and decoder; smaller = stronger information bottleneck.

concepts.title: LeakyReLU activation
concepts.description: max(x, negative_slope * x); allows a small gradient for x<0 and is popular for GAN discriminators where dead ReLU units would starve the generator of signal.

concepts.title: Linear (affine) layer
concepts.description: y = x W^T + b; the basic learnable linear transformation, with weight (out_features, in_features) and optional bias (out_features).

concepts.title: Log-sum-exp numerical stability trick
concepts.description: Subtract the per-row max from logits before exponentiating to keep exp() in range; standard trick to make softmax/log-softmax numerically stable.

concepts.title: Boolean reduction via .any()/.all()
concepts.description: `t.any(tensor, dim=...)` returns True along a dimension if at least one element is True; used to collapse a (ray, segment) intersection matrix to a per-ray boolean.

concepts.title: Backward of 2D matmul
concepts.description: For M = X Y, dL/dX = dL/dM · Y^T and dL/dY = X^T · dL/dM; derived from the chain rule by expressing M_pq = sum_r X_pr Y_rq.

concepts.title: Backward of max with tie-splitting
concepts.description: Backward of max(x,y) wrt x is 1 if x>y, 0 if x<y, 0.5 if x==y (PyTorch convention) so gradients sum to 1; same logic mirrored for y.

concepts.title: MaxPool2d module
concepts.description: Maxpool reduces spatial resolution and surfaces dominant features; e.g. a wheel detector cares about presence anywhere in the receptive field.

concepts.title: MNIST dataset
concepts.description: 60k+10k 28x28 grayscale handwritten digit images used as the classic ML benchmark; the running example throughout the curriculum.

concepts.title: model.apply for recursive submodule action
concepts.description: model.apply(fn) calls fn on every sub-Module; pattern for adding/removing hooks or initializing weights uniformly across an architecture.

concepts.title: model.train() / model.eval() mode toggle
concepts.description: Some modules (batchnorm, dropout) change behaviour between training and eval; call model.train() / model.eval() before the respective loops.

concepts.title: Maxpool padding uses -inf
concepts.description: When padding before a max reduction, fill with -inf so padded cells never win the max (using 0 would corrupt the result for negative-only windows).

concepts.title: Subclassing nn.Module
concepts.description: Inheriting from nn.Module and implementing __init__ (which calls super().__init__()) plus forward gives a callable module; sub-modules and parameters are auto-registered.

concepts.title: Optimizer parameter groups
concepts.description: List of dicts each containing 'params' and per-group hyperparameters, letting you set different learning rates / weight decay for different subsets of parameters.

concepts.title: Pathological curvature / ravine
concepts.description: A 2D toy loss with very different curvatures along x and y (steep ridge plus shallow valley) that exposes weaknesses of plain SGD; used to visualize optimizer trajectories.

concepts.title: permute backward via np.argsort(axes)
concepts.description: For out = transpose(x, axes), dL/dx = transpose(grad_out, np.argsort(axes)); the inverse permutation is found by argsorting the forward axes.

concepts.title: plotly imshow for tensor visualisation
concepts.description: Use plotly_utils.imshow / px.imshow to display 2D tensors as images or animations (facet_col, animation_frame); the chapter's visualization workhorse.

concepts.title: Ray parametric form
concepts.description: Representing a ray as origin point O plus a scalar parameter u times direction vector D, with u in [0, infinity), so any point on the ray is R(u) = O + uD.

concepts.title: 2D ray-segment 2x2 linear system
concepts.description: Setting the ray equation equal to the line equation reduces ray-segment intersection to solving a 2x2 linear system for (u, v) and checking u>=0, v in [0,1].

concepts.title: Ray–triangle intersection 3×3 system
concepts.description: Reducing ray-triangle intersection in 3D to a 3x3 linear system solve over (-D, B-A, C-A) for (s, u, v); intersection iff s>=0, u>=0, v>=0, u+v<=1.

concepts.title: einops Rearrange as nn.Module
concepts.description: `from einops.layers.torch import Rearrange`; used inside nn.Sequential to perform shape changes (e.g. flatten conv feature maps to vectors) declaratively.

concepts.title: register_buffer for non-trainable state
concepts.description: register_buffer stores a tensor on a Module that travels with the model (saved to state_dict, moved with .to) but is not optimized as a parameter; used for running stats in BatchNorm.

concepts.title: ReLU activation
concepts.description: Rectified Linear Unit: f(x) = max(x, 0) applied elementwise; the workhorse nonlinearity for vision MLPs/CNNs.

concepts.title: Backward of reshape is reshape-back
concepts.description: If out = x.reshape(new_shape), grad_x = grad_out.reshape(x.shape) (since reshape doesn't change values, only layout).

concepts.title: ResNet34 architecture
concepts.description: in_layers (Conv7x7 stride 2 → BN → ReLU → MaxPool3x3 stride 2 pad 1), 4 BlockGroups with n_blocks=[3,4,6,3] and out_features=[64,128,256,512], AveragePool, Linear(512,1000).

concepts.title: 3D rotation matrix around y-axis
concepts.description: The 3x3 matrix [[cosθ,0,sinθ],[0,1,0],[-sinθ,0,cosθ]] that rotates a 3D vector counterclockwise about the y-axis by angle θ.

concepts.title: Line segment parametric form
concepts.description: Representing a finite line segment between L1 and L2 as L1 + v(L2-L1) for v in [0,1]; intersection validity requires v in this range.

concepts.title: dist.send / dist.recv primitives
concepts.description: Point-to-point GPU-to-GPU tensor transfer between specific ranks; building blocks for higher-level collectives.

concepts.title: Sequential module container
concepts.description: Sequential(*layers) chains modules together so the forward pass becomes layered application; permits very short forward methods.

concepts.title: Sigmoid activation
concepts.description: 1 / (1 + e^-x); squashes outputs to (0, 1); used as the final layer of the GAN discriminator to convert a single logit to a probability of 'real'.

concepts.title: Simple MLP for MNIST
concepts.description: A two-hidden-layer fully connected classifier: Flatten -> Linear(784,100) -> ReLU -> Linear(100,10) baseline architecture for MNIST.

concepts.title: Slice returns view sharing storage
concepts.description: Basic indexing such as t.tensor[:, 1, 1] returns a view that shares the underlying storage with the original tensor; writes to the view modify the original.

concepts.title: torch.utils.data.Subset for reduced sets
concepts.description: Wrap a Dataset and a list of indices to expose a smaller derived Dataset, useful for fast development cycles or curriculum sub-sampling.

concepts.title: Backward of sum is broadcast
concepts.description: Since broadcasting copies, the inverse (backward) for a sum reduction is broadcasting grad_out back to the original input shape (expanding dims first if keepdim=False).

concepts.title: Triangle surface normal via cross product
concepts.description: Compute a triangle's unnormalized normal as the cross product of two edges from a shared vertex, then divide by its norm to unit-normalize.

concepts.title: Tanh activation
concepts.description: (e^x - e^-x) / (e^x + e^-x); squashes outputs to (-1, 1); used at the generator's output layer when image pixels are normalised to [-1,1].

concepts.title: Tensor unbind along a dim
concepts.description: `tensor.unbind(dim)` removes a dimension and returns a tuple of the slices along that axis, enabling unpacking along non-leading dims.

concepts.title: tensor.amax over multiple dims
concepts.description: amax reduces over one or more dims (returns just values, unlike .max which returns a tuple); used to take maxpool over (kh, kw).

concepts.title: torch.multiprocessing.spawn
concepts.description: Spawn `nprocs` worker processes that run the same function with different rank indices; the standard entrypoint for single-node multi-GPU training.

concepts.title: Unbiased vs biased variance flag
concepts.description: BatchNorm requires the biased (unbiased=False) variance estimate over the batch+spatial dims; differs from the default unbiased=True.

concepts.title: torch.where elementwise selection
concepts.description: t.where(cond, a, b) picks elementwise from a or b based on the boolean condition cond; common pattern for clamping negative values to zero.

concepts.title: torchinfo.summary
concepts.description: Prints layer-by-layer shape and parameter count for a model given a sample input; used to cross-check architectures against a reference.

concepts.title: tqdm progress bar
concepts.description: Wrap a dataloader in tqdm(...) and call pbar.set_postfix(loss=..., epoch=...) to display running metrics on the same line; a standard training UX.

concepts.title: Unbroadcast: sum over broadcasted dims
concepts.description: Reverse the broadcasting that occurred in forward by summing the gradient over prepended dims and dims of original size 1; needed for elementwise ops on differently-shaped inputs.

concepts.title: view vs reshape contiguity
concepts.description: view requires contiguous memory and never copies; reshape may copy if necessary. Mixing them with as_strided requires understanding which guarantees you need.

concepts.title: wandb.Image for image logging
concepts.description: Wrap a numpy/uint8 image in wandb.Image and pass into wandb.log({'images': [...]}); produces a panel of grid images in the wandb UI.

concepts.title: Generic wrap_forward_fn
concepts.description: Factory that turns any numpy_func operating on arrays into a tensor-aware function: unpacks arrays, calls numpy_func, decides requires_grad, attaches a Recipe.

concepts.title: Accumulate (not overwrite) grad on fan-out
concepts.description: When a node has multiple paths to the output, its gradient is the sum of contributions along each path; backprop must accumulate, not overwrite.

concepts.title: Conv2d module
concepts.description: PyTorch Conv2d weight is shaped (out_channels, in_channels, kernel_height, kernel_width); transposed conv swaps in_/out_c order.

concepts.title: All-reduce collective
concepts.description: Aggregation primitive that combines (sum / mean) a tensor across all ranks and broadcasts the result back; used to synchronise gradients in data-parallel training.

concepts.title: as_strided custom view
concepts.description: A tensor's stride tuple gives the byte-step needed to advance one element along each axis; as_strided creates a view with arbitrary size/stride, reinterpreting the underlying buffer.

concepts.title: BackwardFuncLookup registry
concepts.description: A dict from (forward_fn, arg_index) to the corresponding backward function; lets the generic backprop dispatch to per-arg gradient code.

concepts.title: BatchNorm train vs eval behaviour
concepts.description: In training BN uses the current batch's mean/var (and updates running stats); in eval it uses the stored running stats. Forgetting model.eval() is a classic bug.

concepts.title: Inline lambda for reshape-broadcast
concepts.description: BatchNorm's per-channel weight/bias/running stats are vectors of length C; rearrange to (1, C, 1, 1) so they broadcast correctly against (B, C, H, W) tensors.

concepts.title: In-place ops for momentum buffers
concepts.description: Methods ending with _ modify the tensor in place (e.g. b.copy_(...), p.add_(...), p -= ... ); important for optimizer state updates and parameter updates so identities are preserved.

concepts.title: dataclasses.replace for arg update
concepts.description: dataclasses.replace(args, **changes) returns a new dataclass with selected fields overwritten; concise way to plug sweep samples into an args object.

concepts.title: Non-scalar backward via directional derivative
concepts.description: For a non-scalar output g, backward effectively computes the directional derivative L = (g*v).sum() with v = ones by default (or user-supplied end_grad).

concepts.title: Feature extraction by freezing layers
concepts.description: Freeze all weights with model.requires_grad_(False) then redefine (and hence unfreeze) the final classifier layer to point at the new task.

concepts.title: Right branch only when shape changes
concepts.description: When the left branch changes spatial size or channel count, the skip path uses a 1x1 conv + BN with matching stride/channels so the addition's shapes align.

concepts.title: Flatten module
concepts.description: Reshape input by collapsing all dims after a given start_dim into a single dim, e.g. (B, 1, 28, 28) -> (B, 784) for MLP input.

concepts.title: tensor.flip(dims) reverse along axis
concepts.description: Returns a new tensor with the specified dimensions reversed; used to flip kernels for transposed convolution.

concepts.title: Global grad_tracking_enabled flag
concepts.description: Top-level boolean (e.g. grad_tracking_enabled) that, when False, suppresses building Recipes; replicates torch.no_grad / NoGrad context behaviour.

concepts.title: Removing hooks after use
concepts.description: Forward/backward hooks persist on the module until explicitly cleared (e.g. by clearing _forward_hooks); forgetting to remove them is a classic source of confusing bugs.

concepts.title: ImageNet 1000-class labels
concepts.description: Map output class index 0..999 to a human-readable label via a JSON file (imagenet_labels.json); needed to interpret predictions.

concepts.title: ipywidgets interactive sliders
concepts.description: Decorator @interact creates sliders for a function's arguments and re-runs it whenever they change; used to explore ray/segment parametric values live.

concepts.title: torch.isfinite mask
concepts.description: t.isfinite returns a boolean tensor true where values are neither inf nor nan, used to identify which rays actually hit a triangle.

concepts.title: Leaf tensor
concepts.description: Leaf tensors are user-created (no recipe); non-leaf tensors are produced by ops and carry a recipe. Only leaves accumulate .grad in standard autograd.

concepts.title: Derivative of log
concepts.description: d/dx log(x) = 1/x; for a scalar loss L the chain-rule local rule is dL/dx = dL/dout * (1/x).

concepts.title: Inverse lr/batch-size scaling for SGD
concepts.description: For non-adaptive optimizers, larger batch size implies smaller-variance gradients, allowing larger learning rates; adaptive methods are less sensitive to this scaling.

concepts.title: Per-ray min distance over triangles
concepts.description: After computing per-(ray, triangle) intersection distances, reduce over the triangle axis with `min` to get each ray's closest hit (or +inf if it misses everything).

concepts.title: Backward rule for elementwise multiply
concepts.description: For out = x*y, dL/dx = unbroadcast(y * grad_out, x) and dL/dy = unbroadcast(x * grad_out, y); handles broadcasting in the forward pass.

concepts.title: Realize an iterable into a list once
concepts.description: Convert a parameters iterator to a list before iterating multiple times: optimizers iterate over params on every step, but iterators exhaust after one pass.

concepts.title: Parameter-count comparison
concepts.description: Tool that lays out two models' parameter shapes side-by-side; the first row where they disagree pinpoints the first architectural mismatch.

concepts.title: Reshape via Rearrange 'b (c h w) -> b c h w'
concepts.description: Generator's first step maps the latent vector through a Linear layer to a (hidden_channels[0], first_h, first_h) feature map via Rearrange, then BN+ReLU.

concepts.title: RMSprop update rule
concepts.description: v_t = alpha*v_{t-1} + (1-alpha)*g_t^2; divide updates by sqrt(v_t)+eps so dimensions with historically large gradients move less.

concepts.title: Rosenbrock’s banana function
concepts.description: (a-x)^2 + b(y-x^2)^2 + 1 with global minimum at (a, a); features a long narrow parabolic valley along y=x^2 — classic optimizer benchmark.

concepts.title: SGD with momentum
concepts.description: b_t = mu*b_{t-1} + g_t accumulates an exponentially weighted history of gradients; used to smooth updates and accelerate along consistent directions.

concepts.title: Gradient descent update rule
concepts.description: θ_t ← θ_{t-1} - λ ∇L(θ_{t-1}); subtract the gradient times the learning rate to take a finite step in the descent direction.

concepts.title: state_dict load/save
concepts.description: Models expose state_dict() (an OrderedDict of params + buffers) and load_state_dict, used to save weights and copy weights between models with matching structure.

concepts.title: Recipe metadata on a Tensor
concepts.description: Store on each output tensor a Recipe(func, args, kwargs, parents) so backprop can later look up which forward function produced it and which input tensors feed it.

concepts.title: torch.arange / custom arange
concepts.description: torch.arange / np.arange returns [0, 1, ..., n-1]; canonical companion to integer array indexing for batched 'pick correct class' patterns.

concepts.title: torch.save state_dict to disk
concepts.description: Persist a trained model's parameters via torch.save(model.state_dict(), path); the standard serialization endpoint for distributed training and finetuning.

concepts.title: torchvision.models pretrained weights
concepts.description: models.resnet34(weights=ResNet34_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1) downloads ImageNet-trained weights; useful for transfer-learning and as a reference architecture.

concepts.title: Trainer class pattern
concepts.description: Encapsulate model, args, data loaders, optimizers, and the per-step/per-epoch logic inside a single Trainer class with pre_training_setup/training_step/train methods.

concepts.title: Type hints in PyTorch code
concepts.description: Adding type hints to function signatures (list[int], dict[str, float], tuple[...], Optional via | None) documents the code and helps IDEs.

concepts.title: Sweeping the VAE latent space on a grid
concepts.description: Decode a 2D grid of latent points to visualize how the decoder maps the latent space into image space (smooth interpolation hints at a well-formed manifold).

concepts.title: argmax to extract predictions
concepts.description: torch.argmax(logits, dim=1) returns the index of the highest logit per row, used to convert model outputs to discrete predicted classes.

concepts.title: Non-contiguous tensor strides pitfall
concepts.description: Input matrices to as_strided may themselves be non-contiguous (e.g. transposed); always use the input's .stride() rather than assuming the last stride is 1.

concepts.title: Latent noise input to generator
concepts.description: Each batch sample a fresh latent code z from a standard normal distribution and pass through the generator to get fake images.

concepts.title: Adaptive methods vs. plain momentum
concepts.description: Adam's m_t ← β1 m + (1-β1) g is an exponentially weighted moving average (no terminal-velocity blowup); SGD-momentum b_t ← μ b + g accelerates to terminal velocity 1/(1-μ).

concepts.title: Ambient intensity floor
concepts.description: Adding a small constant brightness to every lit triangle so it remains distinguishable from the black background when the diffuse component is zero.

concepts.title: backprop main loop
concepts.description: Iterate the computational graph in reverse-topological order, pulling each node's outgrad from a dict, calling back_funcs for each parent, accumulating their grads.

concepts.title: Per-op backward function signature
concepts.description: For each forward op out = f(x, ...), a backward function takes (grad_out, out, *inputs) and returns dL/dx; uses 'out' when expressing the gradient via the output saves recomputation (e.g. exp).

concepts.title: Barycentric coordinates for triangles
concepts.description: Points inside a triangle ABC are parametrized as A + u(B-A) + v(C-A) with u,v>=0 and u+v<=1.

concepts.title: Singular-matrix identity substitution trick
concepts.description: For batched linear solves, detect singular sub-matrices, replace them with the identity so solve does not throw, then mask out their fake solutions in the final boolean.

concepts.title: Chain rule in computational graphs
concepts.description: dL/dx = dL/dout * d(out)/dx; backward functions implement the local Jacobian piece and multiply by incoming grad_out.

concepts.title: Conv fan-in = in_channels * kernel_h * kernel_w
concepts.description: For convolutional Kaiming init, fan-in is the product of input channels and the kernel spatial extent, since each output value sums over that many products.

concepts.title: F.conv2d functional API
concepts.description: The functional torch.nn.functional.conv2d takes weight and (optional) bias tensors and runs the convolution; backbone of nn.Conv2d.forward.

concepts.title: Decoder mirrors encoder structure
concepts.description: Autoencoder/VAE decoders reverse the encoder topology (convolutions become transposed convolutions, dims grow back), so the bottleneck reconstructs the original shape.

concepts.title: Device fallback (MPS / CUDA / CPU)
concepts.description: Compose `device = t.device("mps" if mps_available else "cuda" if cuda_available else "cpu")` so the same code runs on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, and CPU.

concepts.title: Exponential moving-average update
concepts.description: Update running stats as (1 - mu) * running + mu * new_value; used in BatchNorm running_mean/var and Adam/RMSprop moments.

concepts.title: field(default_factory=...) for mutable defaults
concepts.description: Use default_factory for mutable default values (lists, dicts) in dataclasses to avoid shared mutable defaults across instances.

concepts.title: GAN failure: discriminator wins
concepts.description: Common GAN failure where discriminator becomes perfect (loss → 0) and generator gets no gradient signal; larger models on MNIST tend to fail this way.

concepts.title: GAN generator/discriminator pair
concepts.description: Two networks trained adversarially: generator maps noise z to fake images, discriminator outputs P(real) for an image; equilibrium when the discriminator cannot tell real from generated.

concepts.title: Holdout images for training monitoring
concepts.description: Reserve a small fixed set of input images and periodically log the model's reconstructions/generations on them during training; reveals per-class generation quality.

concepts.title: In-place updates and graph safety
concepts.description: If backward needs the pre-update value of a tensor and you mutated it in-place, the gradient will be wrong; PyTorch raises an error in obvious cases.

concepts.title: Linspace evenly-spaced points
concepts.description: torch.linspace(start, stop, n) returns n evenly spaced points inclusive of both endpoints; used to build coordinate grids for rays and pixels.

concepts.title: Loss landscape
concepts.description: Geometric picture of a scalar loss function over parameter space: contours, valleys, saddles - used to reason about optimizer behaviour.

concepts.title: Module / Parameter from scratch
concepts.description: Define your own Module that auto-discovers nn.Parameter attributes via __setattr__, plus a recursive .parameters() iterator; mirrors PyTorch's Module abstraction on top of the autograd Tensor.

concepts.title: model.modules() iteration
concepts.description: Iterate over every nn.Module in the tree (including the root and nested submodules); used by initialize_weights to selectively reinitialize per-layer-type.

concepts.title: module.requires_grad_(False) freeze
concepts.description: model.requires_grad_(False) recursively turns off gradients on every parameter; calling Linear() on a sub-attribute later re-enables grads for the new layer.

concepts.title: Backward of negation
concepts.description: d/dx (-x) = -1, so the backward returns -grad_out elementwise.

concepts.title: nn.init helper functions
concepts.description: In-place tensor initialisation functions (normal_(mean, std), constant_(value)) commonly used to follow paper-specified init schemes.

concepts.title: is_differentiable flag for non-grad ops
concepts.description: Functions like argmax/eq still go through wrap_forward_fn to box/unbox tensors but skip recipe construction by passing is_differentiable=False.

concepts.title: Need for nonlinear activations
concepts.description: Composing only linear ops gives a linear network; nonlinearities (ReLU/Tanh/Sigmoid/...) are required for universal approximation and depth-as-power.

concepts.title: Outer-product grid via einops.repeat
concepts.description: Generate a 2D grid of y,z values by repeating two 1D linspaces along orthogonal axes; the outer-product pattern needed to build a 2D camera ray grid.

concepts.title: pathlib.Path for project paths
concepts.description: pathlib.Path operations (Path.cwd, /, .exists) provide cross-platform path manipulation, preferred over os.path string concat.

concepts.title: Scale s by Dx to get true ray distance
concepts.description: If a ray's direction has nontrivial x-component (e.g. Dx != 1), the parameter s must be scaled by Dx to convert it into actual distance along the ray.

concepts.title: Residual block
concepts.description: ResBlock has a left branch (conv-bn-relu-conv-bn) and a right branch that is identity if shape-preserving, or 1x1 conv + bn if downsampling/feature-changing.

concepts.title: Right-hand rule triangle orientation
concepts.description: STL/mesh files store triangle vertices in a consistent winding order so that cross-product normals all point outward (or all inward) consistently.

concepts.title: Skip connections cure degradation
concepts.description: Without skip connections, very deep networks suffer the 'degradation problem' (deeper models lose accuracy); residual connections allow identity mappings, fixing it.

concepts.title: Stride-scaling for strided convolution
concepts.description: Implementing a strided conv via as_strided: multiply the per-output stride by the stride hyperparameter so the kernel skips that many input elements per output step.

concepts.title: Quantile-based clamping for display
concepts.description: Before visualising generator output, clamp pixel values to the (q, 1-q) quantile range to suppress outliers that wash out the displayed image.

concepts.title: tensor.pow elementwise power
concepts.description: x.pow(n) (or x**n) computes elementwise exponentiation; used for squared losses and RMSprop/Adam variance updates.

concepts.title: Conversion semantics: numpy <-> tensor
concepts.description: Wrapping numpy arrays into a Tensor object (or vice versa) without unnecessary copies is important to keep training fast; e.g. the part4 Tensor class wraps an Arr.

concepts.title: Conv bias=False before BN
concepts.description: When followed by batchnorm, conv layers are conventionally written with bias=False because BN's affine bias subsumes any constant offset.

concepts.title: torch.rand for uniform initialisation
concepts.description: t.rand(shape) returns a tensor uniformly distributed in [0,1); shifting+scaling produces [-sf, sf] which is the basis of Kaiming-style uniform init.

concepts.title: Transposed convolution (ConvTranspose)
concepts.description: An upsampling op that slides a kernel over the OUTPUT and adds multiples of the kernel; equivalent to spacing the input by stride-1 zeros, padding by kernel_size-1-padding, and running a standard conv with flipped kernel.

concepts.title: Separate optimizers for G and D
concepts.description: GAN training alternates a discriminator step (real and fake samples) and a generator step on the same batch, with separate optimisers for D and G.

concepts.title: Universal approximation theorem
concepts.description: A sufficiently wide single-hidden-layer NN with nonlinear activations can approximate any continuous function on a compact domain to arbitrary precision.

concepts.description: Have the VAE encoder emit a (2, B, latent_dim) tensor so output[0]=mu and output[1]=log_sigma, simplifying downstream sample/forward code.

prerequisite_edges.rationale: [is-a] ReLU is one of the nonlinear activations required to make a deep network non-collapsing.
[is-a] LeakyReLU is a nonlinear activation used in GAN discriminators.
[is-a] Sigmoid is a nonlinear activation squashing outputs to (0,1).
[is-a] Tanh is a nonlinear activation squashing to (-1,1).
[is-a] Plain gradient descent is the canonical descent procedure on the loss landscape.
[is-a] SGD-with-momentum is an instance of the SGD family adding a velocity buffer. | [refines] SGD-momentum refines plain SGD by maintaining a velocity buffer.
[is-a] RMSprop is an SGD variant dividing by the EMA of squared gradients.
[is-a] Adam is an SGD variant combining momentum and adaptive scaling.
[is-a] AdamW is a refinement of Adam decoupling weight decay from the gradient. | [refines] AdamW refines Adam by decoupling weight decay from the gradient update.
[is-a] MSE reconstruction term is one component of the VAE loss.
[is-a] Closed-form KL is the regularizer term in the VAE objective. | [part-of] KL is one of the two terms of the VAE total loss.
[is-a] DCGAN is a specific instance of the generator/discriminator GAN architecture. | [refines] DCGAN refines the generic GAN architecture with conv/convtranspose blocks.
[is-a] ResNet34 uses skip connections to mitigate the degradation problem.
[is-a] Residual blocks instantiate the skip-connection idea.
[is-a] The simple MLP is a concrete nn.Module subclass. | [uses] MLP is built by subclassing nn.Module.
[is-a] An autoencoder is built as an nn-Module subclass containing encoder+decoder. | [uses] Autoencoder is built by subclassing nn.Module.
[is-a] Conv2d is implemented as a module via subclassing nn.Module. | [uses] Conv2d is implemented by subclassing nn.Module.
[is-a] MaxPool2d is implemented as a module via subclassing nn.Module.
[is-a] BatchNorm2d is implemented by subclassing nn.Module.
[is-a] Linear layer is implemented by subclassing nn.Module.
[is-a] Flatten is implemented by subclassing nn.Module. | [uses] Flatten is implemented by subclassing nn.Module.
[is-a] Sequential is itself an nn.Module subclass that chains submodules. | [uses] Sequential is itself an nn.Module subclass.
[is-a] Kaiming uniform is one of the nn.init helper schemes used to initialize weights. | [uses] Kaiming init writes via nn.init.uniform_ / nn.init helpers.
[is-a] DCGAN init uses normal_/constant_ helpers from nn.init. | [uses] DCGAN init calls nn.init.normal_ / constant_.
[is-a] send/recv are primitives provided by the torch.distributed backend.
[is-a] all_reduce is a collective op provided by the initialised distributed backend.
[is-a] broadcast is a collective op provided by the initialised distributed backend.
[is-a] Per-parameter all_reduce of grads is a concrete instance of using the all-reduce collective.
[is-a] CelebA is wrapped in a DataLoader for batched iteration. | [uses] CelebA is consumed via DataLoader.
[is-a] MNIST is wrapped in a DataLoader for batched iteration. | [uses] MNIST is consumed via DataLoader.
[is-a] CIFAR-10 is wrapped in a DataLoader for batched iteration. | [uses] CIFAR-10 is consumed via DataLoader.
[is-a] Rosenbrock's banana is a concrete loss landscape used to benchmark optimizers.
[is-a] The pathological-curvature toy loss is a specific loss landscape exposing optimizer issues.
[is-a] AveragePool is implemented as a module via subclassing nn.Module.
[refines] Adam refines RMSprop by adding a first-moment EMA and bias-correction.
[refines] RMSprop refines momentum-style smoothing by tracking the EMA of squared gradients.
[refines] Adaptive methods refine momentum's terminal-velocity behaviour with EMA scaling. | [uses] SGD-momentum's b_t accelerates to terminal velocity 1/(1-mu).
[refines] VAE encoder refines the autoencoder by emitting a distribution rather than a single latent.
[refines] Mirrored-decoder structure refines the generic autoencoder by specifying transposed-conv decoder topology. | [part-of] Mirrored decoder is a component of the autoencoder architecture.
[refines] DCGAN init refines the default Kaiming scheme with N(0,0.02) per layer.
[refines] Ray-triangle intersection refines the 2D ray-segment linear system to 3D barycentric form.
[refines] Kernel-flip identity refines the abstract transposed-conv definition.
[refines] Fractional-stride zero-insertion refines transposed conv into a concrete implementation recipe.
[refines] Stride-scaling refines the stride-expansion conv to support strides > 1. | [uses] Stride-scaled view feeds into the same einsum contraction.
[refines] Conv-via-strided-expansion-plus-einsum refines the generic stride-then-sum matmul recipe.
[refines] Matmul-via-strides refines the as_strided pattern to a 3D contraction. | [uses] Matmul uses as_strided to materialise the 3D broadcast view.
[refines] Trace-via-diagonal-as-strided refines as_strided with a specific size/stride for diagonals. | [uses] Trace view is produced via as_strided.
[refines] (1,C,1,1) reshape refines the general broadcasting rules to BatchNorm's per-channel use.
[refines] Integer-array indexing refines the general advanced-indexing family with arange + label tensor.
[refines] amax over dims refines einops.reduce(op='max') without the named-axis pattern.
[refines] Global avg pool refines einops.reduce(op='mean') over spatial dims.
[refines] MaxPool padding refines new_full padding with pad_value=-inf so padded cells never win.
[refines] Right-branch-only-when-shape-changes refines the residual block design.
[refines] BlockGroup refines residual blocks into a stride-applied head plus shape-preserving tail.

[refines] torch.inference_mode refines the grad-tracking-disabled idea with a context-manager API. | [alternative-to] torch.inference_mode and a global no-grad flag are alternative ways to disable autograd tracking.
[refines] Feature-extraction freeze refines the requires_grad_(False) toggle with classifier-replacement. | [uses] Feature-extraction uses model.requires_grad_(False).
[refines] Conv+BN pair refines Conv2d by omitting bias when followed by BatchNorm.
[refines] examples-seen step counter refines wandb step usage for batch-size-invariant logging.
[refines] Log-uniform refines the sweep parameter-distribution choice for learning rate.
[refines] MPS/CUDA/CPU fallback refines cuda.is_available() with a multi-backend chain.
[refines] Encoder-output reshape refines reparameterization by packing (mu, log_sigma) into a (2,B,D) tensor.
[refines] Project-and-reshape refines the DCGAN generator's first block. | [part-of] Project-and-reshape is the first block of the DCGAN generator.
[refines] Conv fan-in formula refines Kaiming init for the convolutional case. | [part-of] Conv Kaiming init uses fan_in = in_channels * kh * kw.

[part-of] Within a BlockGroup, only the first block may need the right-branch conv.
[part-of] ResNet34 ends with AveragePool then Linear(512,1000).
[part-of] ResNet34's final 1000-class head is a Linear layer.
